accessibility.info:
Accessible seating is available for wheelchairs and companions.  There is a 4 ticket limit for all accessible seating, unless otherwise posted.

Wheelchair patrons should purchase 1 wheelchair seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Wheelchair companions should also purchase wheelchair seats as their seat.

Please Note: Hearing impaired patrons should contact the box office directly to purchase tickets to ensure additional accommodations are in place.  The box office can be reached by phone at (513) 621-8383 during regular business hours.

Accessible seats are located in Sections 101, 120, 146, 303, 307, 315, 337, 339 and 347 of the stadium.  More information is available by calling (513) 621-8383 during normal business hours or on game days at the Customer Service windows of the North Ticket Office located by Gate C.

events.info: Earlybirds Club is a dance party designed for women, trans, and non-binary folks that starts at 6pm and ends at 10pm - because we have shit to do in the morning! Our DJ spins music from the 80s to 2000s, including pop, hip-hop, new wave, and R&B - you know, the songs you sing at the top of your lungs when no one's home! Earlybirds Club is more than a fun night out, it's a supportive space where kindness, good vibes, and sensible footwear rule, and 10% of proceeds always benefit a local non-profit. Come as you are - there's plenty of room on the dance floor for everyone. 10% of ticket proceeds benefit HER Cincinnati, which empowers women to break the cycles of poverty, addiction, and human trafficking through housing, education, and recovery services. Note: By purchasing these tickets, you are consenting to be photographed for promotional purposes. People of all backgrounds and identities are encouraged to attend all of our events.
